name: src
label: SVG image source
description: URL of the inline svg image to show

name: tokenId
label: Token id
description: The unique key suffix to be added to '--now-illustration-custom-' to enable style design token creation, that will contain the svg image url

name: alt
label: Alt text
description: Alternative text to use on the tag of the illustration. By default, there is no alternative text

name: width
label: Width
description: width for the inline SVG, value including units ex: 100px, 100%, etc

name: height
label: Height
description: height for the inline SVG, value including units, ex: 100px, 100%, etc
